341-4399-4518-8319.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Umori.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Greenhouse Propagator trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greenhouse Propagator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
341-4399-4518-8319.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1322-2023-3755-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-2738-4871-6112.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Fumulus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2173-3944-5220-7918.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying its mana cost.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

64-3617-7370.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Warden of the Eye.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Warden of the Eye from exile to the battlefield.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

215-1526-1753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-1753.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2034-2043-7749.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier token enters, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier token and the two Soldier tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1144-2645-6871-7677.easyPrerequisites: Shimmerwilds Growth is attached to Staff of Domination and has "Green" chosen.
1144-2645-6871-7677.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya.
Shimmerwilds Growth triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Aura Costing One Mana that Enchants Creatures

3953-4050-5968--163.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with the Aura attached, adding one mana of any color.
Mazzy's second ability triggers, exiling the Aura and allowing you to cast it until your next turn.
Cast the Aura from exile by paying its mana cost, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When the Aura enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-3259-4885.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-4885.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-2034-7194.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

2854-4211-4574-6766.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-4211-4574-6766.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4616-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2034-3490-4616-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

884-1116-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
884-1116-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

225-5411-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
225-5411-5531-6621.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-5411-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 8 for the remaining triggers.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

2557-3951-5658.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to create two token copies of Éomer and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Put both Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Éomer tokens trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1116-3240-4506-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-4506-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Civilized Scholar

3439-4284--51.notablePrerequisites: Clone does not have summoning sickness.
3439-4284--51.description:
Activate Clone using Civilized Scholar's ability by tapping it.
Resolve that ability and choose to modify it with dredge, causing you to mill at least one card, return the creature card with dredge from your graveyard to your hand, then discard that same card, untap Clone and fail to transform it.
Repeat.

608-2022-2440-5495.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature, and at least one additional Snake.
It is your turn.
608-2022-2440-5495.description:
Activate Thallid Soothsayer by paying {2} and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card.
An opponent's Wedding Ring's second ability triggers, causing them to draw a card.
Xyris' first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
When the Snake enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Snake you control.
Repeat.
If you control two or more Snakes when you begin the combo, this combo will net near-infinite colorless mana.

1850-4392-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Dismal Backwater from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Dismal Backwater, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Dismal Backwater trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

2249-2762-4050.notablePrerequisites: Thopter Squadron has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2249-2762-4050.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {1}.
When the Thopter dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron.
Repeat.

2146-2562-2992-4050.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying {W}, targeting Living Lightning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Living Lightning, adding {W}.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Graceful Reprieve trigger.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Graceful Reprieve from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Graceful Reprieve trigger, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

339-1636-4630.notablePrerequisites: Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
339-1636-4630.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Sisay by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, searching your library for a legendary creature card with mana value less than Sisay's power and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the legendary creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2879-4067.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent named Volo's Journal with at least three creature types noted.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
Volo does not have summoning sickness.
2879-4067.description:
Activate Volo by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to draw at least four cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Volo.
Repeat.

2290-2445-4158-4772-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Cryptic Trilobite and Spike Feeder have at least one +1/+1 counter.
Your life total is at least four.
2290-2445-4158-4772-4929.description:
Activate Staff of Compleation's third ability by tapping it and paying three life, causing you to put four +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite and Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding six {C} that can only be spent to activate abilitieis.
Activate Staff of Compleation's last ability by paying {5}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana and life, you may activate Staff of Compleation's other abilities.

643-1558-3263-4338.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five other creatures.
643-1558-3263-4338.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creatures.
The creatures die, triggering Rotlung Reanimator five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
